curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'

zoe (product): 7 days is long; ask for 3 business days. maria please negotiate.

omar (solutions): schedule dry run on 2026-07-14 09:00 PT. will gate merge until dry run passes. repo: https://git.redwood.co/partnerships/cloud-bazaar-demo (WIP).
